parts.name: official-front-photo
parts.basis: Manufacturer annotated dimensions and unchanged photo; perspective/registration uncertainty stated separately.

materialBasis: Unchanged manufacturer photograph where mapped; simplified untextured materials are visual estimates, not measured optical properties.
assemblyNotes: Native millimetre dimensions. Photo registration and illustrative layouts do not establish internal electronics or connector mating geometry.

sourceSearch.priority: Manufacturer CAD, then manufacturer dimensioned photographs
sourceSearch.scope: Pinned official product resources and manufacturer repository tree inspected; see S3 source manifests.

limitations: Only the source front surface is reconstructed; depth, hidden PCB structures, connector mating surfaces and HF/LF antenna geometry are UNKNOWN.
Screen position is photograph-derived with about 1.5 mm uncertainty; optical ePaper texture and four-gray waveforms are not simulated.

screen.basis: Official 66.89 x29.05 mm active area, rotated to match the native 128x296 framebuffer. Position from front photograph; firmware rotation is separate.

derivedParts.basis: Annotation of unmodeled reverse/internal structures, not claimed PCB geometry.

photoRegistration.method: Front-face pixel bounds registered to the printed manufacturer dimension; source image is unchanged.

dimensions.basis: official annotated front dimensions; board thickness and reverse geometry UNKNOWN

validation.screenAspectBasis: Manufacturer dimensioned AA 66.89 x29.05 mm for296x128 physical pixels gives a0.43% non-square/annotation aspect difference; preserve official dimensions instead of silently stretching.
